items.title: Does teaching actually cost more time, once you count what comes after?
items.description: Priya's fix took 5 minutes; asking questions took 25. Taken alone, that makes 'just fix it' look cheaper every time. But if the same class of bug comes back later and Sam still can't handle it alone, Priya pays that 5 minutes again — and again. Drag the sliders to see how the two paths' TOTAL mentor time compares once future recurrences of the same bug class are counted in.

params.name: numFutureOccurrences
params.label: Times this class of bug recurs later

params.name: recurrencePercent
params.label: Chance Sam gets stuck again each time, if never taught

items.compute: const directFixMinutes = 5; const teachingExtraMinutes = 20; const expectedRecurrences = params.numFutureOccurrences * (params.recurrencePercent / 100); const mentorTimeIfAlwaysDirect = directFixMinutes + directFixMinutes * expectedRecurrences; const mentorTimeIfTaughtOnce = directFixMinutes + teachingExtraMinutes; return { mentorTimeIfAlwaysDirect, mentorTimeIfTaughtOnce };

outputs.label: Total mentor time — always fix it directly
Total mentor time — teach once (Path B)
